description:
Get recent US regulatory changes from BIS and OFAC.

Returns Federal Register publications including entity list updates,
rule changes, country policy shifts, and new sanctions programs.

Examples:
  federal_register_changes()                          # Last 30 days, all
  federal_register_changes(agency="OFAC", days=7)     # OFAC changes this week
  federal_register_changes(category="entity_list", severity="critical")

Use case: 'Any new entity list additions affecting China?'

agency.description: Optional: "BIS" (Bureau of Industry and Security) or "OFAC" (Office of Foreign Assets Control). Omit it for both.

category.description: Optional: "entity_list", "rule_change", "country_policy" or "sanctions". Omit it for every category.

days.description: Days to look back, 1-365 (default 30). A value outside the range is refused.

limit.description: Maximum number of changes to return (default 50).

severity.description: Optional: "critical", "high", "medium" or "low". Omit it for every level.

name: federal_register_changes
title: Federal Register Export and Sanctions Changes
